name: Delete Sales Persons
summary: Permanently deletes sales person records, matched by externalSalesPersonId (default) or Marketo ID. Up to 300 per call.
whenToUse: Rarely — to clean up rep records that should no longer exist in Marketo. There is no undo.
confirm: This PERMANENTLY deletes up to 300 sales person records. Leads/opportunities that referenced them keep their externalSalesPersonId value, but the rep record is gone. Continue?

body.hint: Comma-separated external IDs to delete — usually the rep's email.

fields.name: deleteBy
fields.label: Delete by
fields.hint: If you switch to idField, paste Marketo IDs in the values box instead. Each record may contain only the one matching key.

response.description: Per record: status and reason when skipped.
